title: Sulfur-doped g-C3N4/g-C3N4 isotype step-scheme heterojunction for photocatalytic H2 evolution

nodes.label: Pristine g-C3N4 evolves little H2 under visible light; efficient metal-free photocatalysts are needed

attrs.note: no introduction in packet; need framed from domain knowledge and title

nodes.label: S-doping g-C3N4 to pair S-doped and S-free domains as an isotype S-scheme heterojunction should raise H2 evolution

requires_unseen: title: 'Sulfur-doped g-C3N4/g-C3N4 isotype step-scheme heterojunction for photocatalytic H2 evolution'

nodes.label: Host: melamine-derived g-C3N4, thermally exfoliated to thin, wider-spaced g-C3N4-E that admits liquid sulfur

requires_unseen: exfoliated layers are thinner and wider spaced, convenient for sulfur intercalation (linked text F1)
attrs.image_note: F1 draws melamine -> g-C3N4 -> g-C3N4-E with layers drawn further apart

nodes.label: Introduce S dopants by loading molten sulfur into g-C3N4-E, then pyrolysing off the excess sulfur

requires_unseen: sulfur powder melts to liquid sulfur during hydrothermal step; pyrolysis removes S other than dopants (linked text F1)
attrs.site: lattice (S shown on N sites in F1 inset)
attrs.amount: 0.53 at% S by XPS (linked text F4); g-C3N4-E:S mass ratio 1:7 (linked text F6, Fig. S3)

nodes.label: Thermal polycondensation of melamine at 520 C in air gives bulk g-C3N4
Thermal exfoliation of bulk g-C3N4 at 580 C in air gives g-C3N4-E nanosheets
Hydrothermal treatment of g-C3N4-E with sulfur at 180 C gives sulfur-loaded S@g-C3N4-E
Pyrolysis of S@g-C3N4-E at 520 C under N2 gives S-g-C3N4-E
Sulfur is bonded into the heptazine framework as C-S-C (S on N sites) in S-g-C3N4-E

requires_unseen: S 2p at 164.5-164.7 eV = C-S-C bond (k2; linked text F4, ref [39])
S sits on N sites in the heptazine unit (F1 inset drawing; linked text F4 'doping of sulfur into the framework')
attrs.note: built from XPS S 2p presence/assignment (o10, k2), N 1s shift (o9), EDS S map (via n23), absence of elemental S (via n18)

nodes.label: S-g-C3N4-E is highly porous: SBET 173.53 m2/g and Vpore 0.888 cm3/g, >10x g-C3N4-E and S@g-C3N4-E

attrs.mechanism_note: paper attributes pores to sulfur-vapour self-foaming during pyrolysis (linked text F1, F5)

nodes.label: S-doped (R-type) and S-free (O-type) domains in contact form an isotype S-scheme heterojunction with an internal field

attrs.image_note: F9 schematic labels S-free / S-doped, Contact Surfaces, O-typed / R-typed domains, field E; band edges -0.50/2.25 V and -0.64/2.21 V vs RHE are drawn, their measurement is not in the packet
attrs.fig_note: F9 has no panel records; whole figure read

nodes.label: Internal field recombines O-domain CB electrons with R-domain VB holes, leaving R-domain electrons (-0.64 V) to reduce H+ and O-domain holes (2.25 V) to oxidise TEOA
Photogenerated charges separate more efficiently and recombine less in S-g-C3N4-E than in g-C3N4 and g-C3N4-E

requires_unseen: higher photocurrent, PL quench and longer lifetime read as better charge separation (k5, prior knowledge; linked text F7, F8)
fitted PL lifetimes (Table S3, linked text F8; o28)
attrs.note: reading of photocurrent, PL quench and PL lifetime via k5
